purpose: Registration fragment for the Todo board application. The platform side already exists and works: agent 19620bec serves the board through the authenticated Airlock app and the Todo MCP resource is already registered in the platform. What is missing is the catalogue entry in integrations/airlock-apps/apps.json and the UI-gateway entry. Merges into apps.json; the registry itself is read-only for this task and nothing was rebuilt.

catalog_entry_to_merge.name: Todo
catalog_entry_to_merge.operations_note: The MCP resource advertises 9 tools. kanban.source.admit and kanban.catalog.link are left out on purpose: both take a signed canonical envelope and are not meant to be typed into a console. The arguments above come from the tool schemas stored with the resource (kanban.list: limit/tag/column/project; kanban.read: cardId; kanban.change: mode + optional fields; kanban.delete: cardId; kanban.project.ensure: name/externalKey; kanban.capture_inbox: transcript).

principal.note: The binding carries no principal field: with a single binding and an empty principal the shared adapter serves it to every app admin. The Todo MCP resource is shared (credential_mode=shared), so its stored credential is reused without a second secret.

platform_rule.text: binding.user_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM CASE WHEN need.binding_mode='shared' THEN NULL ELSE $1::uuid END AND (m.owner_principal_id = creator.id OR EXISTS (resource_grants with 'use' for creator))
platform_rule.consequence: A shared MCP resource resolves only while its owner_principal_id equals the binding creator (binding.created_by_user_id), or the creator holds a 'use' grant.
platform_rule.verified_by: read-only SELECT: resource 4b0302bc owner_principal_id=5e438326 and the existing binding (exmanager / todo_board) created_by_user_id=5e438326 -> the rule holds; the platform refreshed the tool schemas of this resource on 2026-10-23 10:42 UTC, which only happens with a working credential.

ui_gateway.file: ~/.config/airlock-apps/ui-gateway.json (5 entries: noticeplace, universal-userio, gptadmin, agent-herder, grepmesh)
ui_gateway.env_var: no ui_gateway_key for this agent (the 5 gateway apps have one)
ui_gateway.why_it_matters: the application does not need the gateway today: its own adapter already serves the board through the authenticated Airlock app. The gateway is only required if the application is rebuilt from the shared adapter, whose UI path signs a bridgeauth assertion and expects the gateway to proxy to the product.

blockers.severity: blocking for the MCP variant, harmless for the catalogue variant
blockers.symptom: scripts/airlock_apps.py upload --app todo-board would PUT the shared adapter source to agent 19620bec and replace its own Todo workspace proxy
blockers.cause: one agent holds one source; the shared adapter has no Todo routes, no static asset and no /link-preview, and its UI path needs ui_gateway_key plus a ui-gateway.json entry, otherwise the native route answers 503 'Подключение интерфейса пока не настроено'
blockers.fix: two variants, both prepared below: variant A touches only apps.json and changes nothing at runtime; variant B does the upload and therefore requires the ui-gateway entry, the bridgeauth key and the env var to be in place BEFORE the upload
blockers.verified: read-only comparison of the runtime manifests and the shared source (integrations/airlock-apps/main.go registers one catch-all route plus the service_read tool; the todo-board manifest carries its own routes and a static asset)

blockers.symptom: the gateway proxy would reach the board without a board session and the board would answer its own login page
blockers.cause: cmd/ui-gateway/main.go passes X-Authenticated-User-* headers and drops the Authorization header; the modes it knows are noticeplace, userio, gptadmin, herder and grepmesh, and the board reads none of them (its own work-auth cookie gateway is the only gate)
blockers.fix: either give the board a mode that maps the Airlock principal to a board session, or keep variant A and leave the board UI where it is (the application agent already serves it). This is a product-side decision for the owner.
blockers.verified: grep over /home/roomhacker/excode (excluding node_modules) found no Airlock identity handling

notes: The Todo board is a real product with a live MCP endpoint and 54 run-app records; it was never a canary. What was missing is only the catalogue entry and the gateway entry.

The Todo MCP resource 4b0302bc and its encrypted credential must survive any registry cleanup: the resource lives in agent_mcp_servers and is shared, only the binding rows belong to an agent. The current consumer is exmanager.
The application agent 19620bec has 0 needs and 0 tools, so the platform cannot call the board through this application yet - the board is only reachable through the resource via exmanager.
Adding the catalogue entry changes nothing at runtime; only an upload of the shared adapter would change the running application, and that is the step that needs the owner's decision.
